entries.definition: a person who lacks knowledge of evil
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the absence itself rather than cooing over the person, so the warmth of *dear* gives way to something closer to unguardedness.

entries.definition: a sweet innocent mild-mannered person (especially a child)
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Tender in the same way as *dear* but with the creature behind it, so the gentleness comes with defencelessness attached.

entries.definition: a person who has never had sex
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: States a plain fact about a person's experience and attaches no fondness or reproach to it.

entries.definition: someone who admires a young woman
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the feeling entirely on one side — his admiring of her — with nothing in the word saying it is returned.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Tender in a way that casts the beloved as small and to be cosseted, which *sweetheart* does not do.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Doting and unembarrassed, the most lavish of these terms of endearment.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Gentle and well-mannered where *love* is bare — affection kept quiet rather than declared.
examples: Write to me very often, my dear.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The superlative does the work — it does not merely call the person dear but sets them above everyone else.

entries.definition: a special loved one
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmth arrived at by comparison: this one is loved specially, which implies others ranked below.
examples: the godson, the friend, the favourite of his father!
a great favourite with her Longbourn nieces

entries.definition: a man who is the lover of a man or woman
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A bare designation of the man in the relation, carrying none of the warmth that *darling* pours out.

entries.definition: a girl or young woman with whom a man is romantically involved
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat beside the endearments: it identifies her wholly by a man's romantic involvement rather than expressing any feeling toward her.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Homely and sweet-tasting warmth, comfortable where *dearest* is fervent.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The simplest of these endearments, naming the feeling outright with nothing decorative added to it.
examples: Come here, my love, and sit by the fire.

entries.definition: a person who loves someone or is loved by someone
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Works from either side of the bond — the one who loves or the one who is loved — and states the relation rather than performing it.
examples: The acknowledged lovers talked and laughed; the unacknowledged were silent.
these violent young lovers carry everything their own way

entries.definition: a special loved one
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Fondness with a stroking, indulgent hand in it, where *favourite* under the same sense is merely preference.

entries.definition: (slang) a person's girlfriend or boyfriend
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Slang, and breezily physical: it holds a girlfriend or boyfriend at a jaunty distance from the tenderness of *sweetheart*.

entries.definition: a beloved person; used as terms of endearment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the beloved by the heart itself, wholesome and unironic in a way *baby* is not.

entries.definition: a woman of refinement
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunt and breezy where the rest are courteous — it grants the refinement but withholds the deference.

entries.definition: a woman of refinement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The stateliest of the set — it treats refinement as her whole standing rather than a courtesy paid in passing.

entries.definition: a woman of refinement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word for it — the refinement is granted without ceremony, where *gentlewoman* makes an occasion of it.
examples: a chauffeur opened the door of the limousine for the grand lady
She behaved like a lady at every moment of the visit.

entries.definition: a woman of refinement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Deferential — respect offered to her rather than refinement described about her, and warmer than the starched *madam*.

entries.definition: a woman of refinement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and ceremonious, the courtesy held at a polite distance where *ma'am* closes it.

entries.definition: a person who founds or establishes some institution
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and unadorned - it credits the act of starting an institution and stops there, without the honour *father* confers on the same person.

entries.definition: a person who founds or establishes some institution
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reverent - it casts the one who established the institution as its progenitor, giving the thing founded a lineage and the founder a claim on gratitude.
examples: George Washington is the father of his country
He is honoured as the father of the modern hospital.
The fathers of the new school met to draw up its rules.

entries.definition: a friend who is frequently in the company of another
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The coolest of the words for frequent company, recording the habit and withholding any verdict on the affection behind it.

entries.definition: a close friend who accompanies their buddies in their activities
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Openly affectionate for the same close, always-along friend, where *crony* leaves the fondness unspoken.

entries.definition: a close friend who accompanies their buddies in their activities
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measures closeness in activities shared with a whole set of buddies, so the friendship is company kept rather than confidences given as in *intimate*.

entries.definition: a person you know well and regard with affection and trust
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain, unhedged word for the bond, holding affection and trust together where *associate* names only the company kept.
examples: he was my best friend at the university
"Delighted to see their dear friend again"
"I see your design, Bingley," said his friend.
